combine: mean of a day over years a…b = (S[b] − S[a−1]) / (N[b] − N[a−1]); a year e left out subtracts (S[e] − S[e−1]) and (N[e] − N[e−1])
layout: sum_MMDD.npy [channel, year, lat, lon] float32, count_MMDD.npy the same shape uint8, both CUMULATIVE over the years: plane (c, y) = every frame of that calendar day in years year_first … year_first + y. Plane offset = header_len + (c * n_years + y) * H * W * itemsize.
